name: BlobMail Loopback
description: Fixture-only BlobMail composer, verified local blob reconstruction, and decrypted inbox for protocol review.

notes: Uses the public content-app context, guarded local storage, diagnostics, and dock lifecycle only.
Bundles the BlobMail Sprint 0 protocol and RFE-derived local transport; no runtime import leaves the package.

settings.label: BlobMail Loopback
settings.description: Enable the fixture-only BlobMail app in this custom build.

settings.label: Save fixture inbox
settings.description: Keep up to 12 decrypted fixture messages as plaintext in local extension storage. Off by default.

reset.warning: Turning persistence off does not remove prior fixture history; use Clear local fixture data in the app.

notes: Exports boot, open, close, disable, and dispose and checks the runtime abort signal before asynchronous writes.
The only message action runs deterministic fixtures in memory after explicit review.
Uses milXdy semantic overlay tokens and contains no host-page selectors.

hub.shortDescription: Compose and decrypt local BlobMail fixtures with replayable evidence.
hub.longDescription: A text-only protocol lab. It encrypts to deterministic test identities, packs an Ethereum-blob-shaped fixture in memory, reconstructs and verifies bytes, and decrypts locally. It does not publish, deliver, connect a wallet, or use a network.
permissionNotes: Requests no host, optional, network, wallet, onchain, signing, transaction, or background capability.
dataNotes: Processes bounded message text locally against deterministic Alice and Bob fixture identities.
Decrypted bytes are validated as strict UTF-8 and rendered as inert text.
localStorageNotes: Enablement and persistence consent use declared local keys.
When opted in, stores at most 12 decrypted fixture messages in plaintext; clear is user-controlled.

permissionNotes: No host, network, background, wallet, onchain, signing, transaction, funded-key, or secret access.
dataNotes: Message text never leaves the local fixture engine.
Deterministic test private keys are derived in memory and are not user identities, funded keys, or production secrets.
Local decryption proves only fixture reconstruction and recipient authentication, not public delivery or availability.
localStorageNotes: Persistence is off by default and requires an explicit app-surface choice.
Opt-in state is bounded to 12 plaintext fixture messages and can be cleared inside the app.

notes: Fixture-only Sprint 0 handoff; local composition requires explicit package-consent acknowledgement.
Not reviewed for testnet or production use.
